newsitem.title: USA: Man faces 50 years prison for shooting pie-eater.
newsitem.headline: Man faces 50 years prison for shooting pie-eater.

text.p: A 41-year-old Louisiana man faces up to 50 years in prison after being convicted of shooting his girlfriend's brother for eating a slice of his lemon meringue pie.

Lester "Bear" Bryant was convicted on Wednesday of attempted second-degree murder for shooting Paul Thomas in the chest last August for eating a piece of the pie he had warned everyone in his house not to touch.
Prosecutor Tony Clayton said after the trial that the verdict showed local residents would not stand for violence over a piece of lemon meringue pie.
"However, it it were a piece of my mama's apple pie, it might have been a different verdict," Clayton said.
Thomas, who was shot just below his throat, made a full recovery.
